THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

The allotments of land described as Lots ‘A’, ‘B’, ‘C’, ‘D’, ‘E’,‘F’ and ‘G’ in total extent of about 84.8065 Hectares, depicted inAdvance Tracing No. R/KLW/2005/99 and dated 08.09.2009,prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village ofIliumbakanda (F.V.P. 932) in the Uda Pattuwa Minor Division inKukulu Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kalawana inRatnapura District in Sabaragamuwa Province and bounded asfollows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 60.5629 HectaresNorth: Lot No. 659; East: Lot No. 75; South: Lot No. 413; West:Lot Nos. 75, 95 and Lot No. 70 (T P. 105552).
02. Lot ‘B’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 16.3817 HectaresNorth: Lot No. 659; East: Lot No. 70 and (T P. 99544) and (T P.99545) Lot No. 76; South: Lot Nos. 76 and 93; West: Lot No. 75.
03. Lot ‘C’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 0.3926 HectareNorth: Lot No. 76; East: Lot No. 70 (T P. 99544); South: LotNo. 92; West: Lot Nos. 92 and 76.
04. Lot ‘D’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 0.5579 HectareNorth: Lot Nos. 76 and 92; East: Lot No. 92; South: LotNo. 378; West: Lot No. 76.
05. Lot ‘E’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 4.6404 HectaresNorth: Lot No. 93; East: Lot Nos. 76 and 378; South: LotNo. 378; West: Lot No. 75.
06. Lot ‘F’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 0.0053 HectareNorth: Lot No. 94; East: Lot No. 75; South: Lot Nos. 75 and 74;West: Lot No. 74.
07. Lot ‘G’ – Moradolahena – Extent: About 2.2657 HectaresNorth: Lot No. 95; East: Lot Nos. 74 and 75; South: Lot Nos. 75and 378; West: Lot No. 70 (T P. 105552).
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
Ref. No.: 03J/92/FR/304.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.02nd August, 2018.
